summary: A six-panel baseball cap: a domed crown that sits on the skull, a curved peak, and a rear closure band. options channel0, channel1; sockets grip_r, grip_l, holster_r, sling_back.
setup: Spawn it with Prefabs.garment_head_cap_plain or place "prefab": "garment_head_cap_plain" in a scene; Game(plugins=[...]) needs physics3d().
